sentences.text: Cheese in the Trap is a South Korean television series starring Park Hae-jin , Kim Go-eun , Seo Kang-joon and Lee Sung-kyung .	Cheese in the Trap	Cheese in the Trap	Park Hae-jin	Park Hae-jin	Kim Go-eun	Kim Go-eun	Seo Kang-joon	Seo Kang-joon	Lee Sung-kyung	Lee Sung-kyung	South Korean television series	Korean drama
It aired on the cable network tvN on Mondays and Tuesdays for 16 episodes between 4 January -- 1 March 2016 .	tvN	TVN (South Korea)

The series is based on the webtoon of the same name , serialized on Naver from 2010 -- 2016 , although it featured an original ending since the webtoon had not been completed at the time of filming .	webtoon	webtoon	the same name	Cheese in the Trap	Naver	Naver
As of August 2016 , the series is in the process of being adapted into a film version , starring Park Hae-jin opposite a new lead actress .	Park Hae-jin	Park Hae-jin
The Korean-Chinese production team are holding open casting auditions for the female lead in advance of shooting , which is scheduled to commence in early 2017 .
